from pathlib import Path
prog='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    freq = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = freq.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            col = grid[r][c]
            if col == bg or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            for y,x in q:
                cells.append((y,x))
                for ny,nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == col:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
            minr=min(y for y,x in cells); minc=min(x for y,x in cells)
            shape=tuple(sorted((y-minr,x-minc) for y,x in cells))
            maxr=max(y for y,x in cells)-minr+1; maxc=max(x for y,x in cells)-minc+1
            comps.append(dict(color=col,cells=cells,shape=shape,box=(maxr,maxc),top=minr,left=minc))
    # A repeated, two-dimensional shape identifies the object to recolor.
    byshape={}
    for obj in comps:
        if obj['box'][0] > 1 and obj['box'][1] > 1:
            byshape.setdefault(obj['shape'], []).append(obj)
    matches=[items for items in byshape.values() if len({o['color'] for o in items}) > 1]
    if not matches:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    pair=max(matches, key=lambda items: max(o['box'][0]*o['box'][1] for o in items))
    # The gray target is used when present; otherwise the upper matching object is the target.
    target=next((o for o in pair if o['color']==9), None)
    if target is None:
        target=min(pair, key=lambda o:(o['top'],o['left']))
    target_color=target['color']
    # Recolor it with the color of the largest other object.
    others=[o for o in comps if o['color'] != target_color]
    if not others:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    dest=max(others, key=lambda o:len(o['cells']))['color']
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in target['cells']:
        out[r][c]=dest
    return out
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); p.write_text(prog)
print(p, p.stat().st_size)
